title: The Wise and Foolish Builders
reflectionQuestion: What do you think it felt like inside the strong house on the rock, while the storm blew all around outside?
kidSafetyNotes: PARABLE. Pairs with 1816 (Jesus Calms the Storm): 1816 = 'Jesus is with you IN the storm,' this = 'build on Jesus BEFORE the storm.' Sand house washes away GENTLY -- no one in it, no scary collapse ('slowly, quietly, the little house slipped away'). KEY theology edit (Adam): 'strong and STEADY' not 'strong and safe' -- obedience gives steadiness THROUGH storms, never a guarantee bad things won't come (see feedback_kid_god_with_not_cause / faithful_not_gentle). Wise builder 'she' / foolish 'he' (gender variety). Promoted to short+full (storm drama earns it). One image: two houses in the storm, one standing, one washing away.
